item.title: Byron Brown reflects on historic firsts, Black leaders he's known, at 400 Towers Black History Month dinner
item.description: Byron Brown, president and CEO of Western New York Off-Track Betting, speaking at 400 Towers on Friday for a Black History Dinner.Photo by Howard Owens In a speech Friday at 400 Towers for Black History Month, Byron Brown, president and CEO of Western Regional Off-Track Betting, spoke about some of the important Black leaders he's met during his nearly three-decade political career and shared some of his own history-making achievements.
